name: Perplexity Pages
tagline: Perplexity Pages is a publishing feature that turns any Perplexity research session into a polished, shareable article with cited sources, images, and structured sections. Unlike a raw AI conversation, a Page looks like a real article — complete with an introduction, chapters, and a references list — and can be shared publicly or kept private. Researchers, educators, and content creators use Pages to quickly produce well-sourced reference documents on any topic, with the AI handling research, writing, and citation formatting simultaneously.
